entity_types.name: Contract
entity_types.description: A specific funded agreement between parties, identified as one thing by the source — an award, a task order, a grant. A programme that funds many awards is not itself a Contract unless the source names it as a single agreement.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: A company, agency, university, laboratory, or other body that acts as one. A division named only in passing is part of its parent, not its own Organization, unless the source treats it as acting on its own behalf.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: An individual human being named by the source. A role held by nobody in particular is not a Person, and neither is a team, a department, or a job title with no name attached to it.

entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: A specific thing offered for sale or delivery under its own name — a model, a platform, a system. Distinct from Technology: a Product is the article, the Technology is what makes it work.

entity_types.name: Science
entity_types.description: A field of study or a body of underlying principle — fluid dynamics, materials science, machine learning theory. Distinct from Technology: Science is what is understood, Technology is what is built with it.

entity_types.name: Technology
entity_types.description: A capability or technical approach that can be built into things — a propulsion method, a sensing technique, an architecture. Not a product you can buy, which is a Product, and not the underlying principle it rests on, which is a Science.

relationship_types.name: Acquires
relationship_types.description: The first organization acquires the second, taking ownership of it. The direction is acquirer to acquired. An investment, a partnership, a supplier arrangement, or a merger of equals is not an acquisition.

relationship_types.name: Contract Develops
relationship_types.description: The contract funds work that builds or advances this technology. Naming a technology as background is not developing it.

relationship_types.name: Contract Researches
relationship_types.description: The contract funds study in this field.

relationship_types.name: Develops
relationship_types.description: The organization builds or advances this technology itself. Buying or using it is not developing it.

relationship_types.name: Employs
relationship_types.description: The organization employs this person, or the person holds a named position at it. A person merely quoted about an organization is not employed by it.

relationship_types.name: Enters
relationship_types.description: The organization is a party to this contract — it was awarded it, signed it, or is named as performing it. An agency that awarded the contract is also a party and belongs here.

relationship_types.name: Point Of Contact
relationship_types.description: The person the contract names as a contact — principal investigator, technical contact, contracting officer. Somebody mentioned in the same paragraph is not a point of contact.

relationship_types.name: Researches
relationship_types.description: The organization conducts study in this field. Applying an established result is not researching it.

relationship_types.name: Sells
relationship_types.description: The organization offers this product commercially. A reseller or distributor counts; a customer does not.

relationship_types.name: Supports
relationship_types.description: This field of study is the principle the technology rests on — the source states the technology works because of it.

relationship_types.name: Uses
relationship_types.description: The product is built with this technology, as the source describes it — a specification, a feature, a stated approach.

id.description: A short id you assign, unique within this response.

name.description: What the source calls this thing.

to.description: The id of the entity at the to end.
